title: Warm kale, apple and gammon salad

grandparents_cupboard.reason: Every item is a plain whole food or a traditional condiment such as wholegrain mustard, cider vinegar and honey.

supermarket.reason: Gammon steaks, kale, apples, walnuts and the rest are everyday items at any mainstream UK supermarket.

basic_kitchen.reason: It needs only a pan, a frying pan and a bowl, and massaging kale and frying gammon are simple techniques.

works.reason: 750g potatoes, 200g kale and four gammon steaks make a sensible dinner for four, with a balanced dressing and clear timings.

honest_times.reason: Twenty-five minutes covers halving potatoes, shredding kale, slicing apple and onion, massaging and frying the gammon, and 15 minutes matches the potato boil.

honest_ingredients.reason: Every listed ingredient and seasoning is used, nothing unlisted appears apart from water, and the names match their ids.

seasonal_feel.reason: A warm kale salad with new-season apples suits late September, and the massaged kale is the base of the dish.

plain_voice.reason: The steps are short, clear and in plain British English.

hearty_healthy.reason: It is a filling plate of potatoes, greens, fruit, nuts and gammon that a family would happily eat again.
